recipes.lesson: Use `caelestia-desktop yt-play` (skips header `--min-y 185` & checks `pactl list sink-inputs` `Corked: no`); never rely on `playerctl` for Firefox.

recipes.topic: LibreOffice Flatpak file access & Word styling
recipes.lesson: Save `.docx` in `~/Documents/` (Flatpak cannot read `/tmp`); embed images/tables via `caelestia-desktop write-docx --image` or `office-paste --image`.

recipes.topic: Toggle Night Light without changing power mode
recipes.lesson: Use `caelestia shell modes setNightLight true 3500` directly (<0.1s) instead of switching into full `sleep` mode unless user asked for battery saver.

Avoid thin JS/SPA stub pages (<1200 chars); auto-enrich from hit #2, fetch keyword-verified artwork (>=360px), and translate Word docs to Vietnamese when prompt is Vietnamese even if chatLanguage=auto.

recipes.topic: YouTube search chip & Shorts skip rule
recipes.lesson: Scan YouTube results with min_y>=245 & title length>=18 chars to skip Shorts/chips; retry hits[1] cleanly before Round-2 fallback.
Reject MSN/privacy-wall stubs cleanly (`cares about your privacy`); advance to hits[1..2] direct tech news sites or escalate to Round-2 search_web recovery.

recipes.topic: Guaranteed multi-image & YouTube capture for Word
recipes.lesson: Use `web-copy --image-count N` + keyword-filtered DDG `i.js` fallback and `yt-play --screenshot` + `write-docx --images` when multiple images are requested.
